Cupid Ltd. raises FY27 profit and revenue guidance after strong growth

Cupid Limited has raised its revenue guidance for FY27 to ₹725-750 crore and its net profit guidance to ₹210-225 crore, following a strong performance in the June quarter. The company reported a 142% increase in revenue and a 194% increase in profit for the quarter. Cupid Limited cited expansion in manufacturing, consumer distribution, and international healthcare as factors supporting its medium-term growth plans. Following the announcement, the company's shares rose 6% to ₹273.85, having already gained 160% in 2026.
